reviews.body: Thanks for the clean fix. I checked the aggregation in `DAGExecutor.execute`: `carried_ids` is snapshotted from steps already completed when the call starts, so the post-loop total only adds usage from steps this round actually ran, then combines it with the existing `plan.total_usage`. That matches the #62 replan inflation case. The new `test_carried_step_usage_not_recounted` covers the regression (100 + 10 = 110, not 210) and would fail without the change. CLA is signed and CI is green.
